title: Transplant status and rejection
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's transplant status or transplant complication only.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for stable status post-lung transplant.

HPI
The patient is a 36-year-old woman who presented for a routine follow-up regarding her status four years after a double lung transplant. She reports feeling well and maintains a good quality of life. She denies any respiratory distress, significant fatigue, or new symptoms. She remains stable on her current immunosuppressive regimen with no reported side effects. She reports compliance with all medications and attends regular monitoring appointments.

Medication List
Tacrolimus 2mg daily
Mycophenolate mofetil 500mg twice daily
Prednisone 5mg daily

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. She is alert and oriented. Breath sounds are clear bilaterally. Respiratory effort is normal. Pulse is 72, blood pressure is 118/76, and oxygen saturation is 98% on room air.

Assessment
The patient is a 36-year-old woman who is doing well four years following a double lung transplant. She shows no signs of transplant complication or rejection.

Plan
Continue current immunosuppressant medications as prescribed. Schedule follow-up in three months for routine monitoring.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 05/14/2026
